title: feat: add model search filters
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
- Searches canonical IDs, titles, descriptions, publishers, base models, modalities, and capabilities with AND semantics.
- Adds frontend-only `access`, `publisher`, `id`, `type`, and `capability` qualifiers; unknown syntax remains literal text and publisher matching uses the public community ID prefix.
- Keeps the existing URL-backed query, scope, category, and sort flow unchanged, and documents filter values in a compact keyboard-accessible help tooltip.
- Tests: `npx vitest run test/model-query.test.ts test/model-categories.test.ts` (30 passed); UI tooltip tests (2 passed); `npx tsc --noEmit`; frontend Vite production build; Biome check.

Fixes #13907

gist.headline: The model garden got filters
gist.blurb: The model picker can now understand a little more than a hopeful keyword. Tell it what kind of pollen you need, and it will stop wandering through the whole garden.
gist.summary: Added AND-based model search across canonical IDs, titles, descriptions, publishers, base models, modalities, and capabilities, plus frontend qualifiers for access, publisher, id, type, and capability.
gist.impact: Users can narrow the existing URL-backed model browser with queries like publisher: or capability: while keeping its current scope, category, and sorting controls intact.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny librarian-gardener in a cozy model garden, using labeled seed packets and a magnifying glass to sort code-plants by publisher, type, access, and capability. A retro terminal shows a compact search bar with simple qualifier chips, while neatly organized flowering pots make the new precision feel tangible.
